notes.title: Update: Tutorial Improvements and LIV Support
notes.content:
We've just rolled out an update to RPG Merchant that addresses some feedback regarding the Challenge modes. 

We realised that players who skipped the Story levels and went straight to Challenge mode or Endless mode were not shown how to use the item variant switching mechanic, which lets you change an item into a Gilded (two star) or Enchanted (three star) variant that customers might ask for. Some players may have found these levels unplayable if customers asked for these items too often.

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31936157/f81b255f41563bbaaf48769b00dc0b8045378681.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31936157/c3f21d09cf4f949009c0d24e390f5db83cb3af2c.jpg[/img][/url]

To fix this, we've added a reminder to the tutorials for all Challenge and Endless modes that explains this mechanic.

If you prefer to skip the tutorials, here's the quick version: press the [b]thumbstick[/b] (Oculus Touch) or [b]touchpad[/b] (Vive) on an item you're holding to cycle through its variants. Press once for two stars, twice for three stars, and again to reset to one star. The customer's icon will highlight yellow when you give them the correct variant.

We hope this makes these modes easier to play if you haven't gone through the Story mode. This was an oversight on our part, and we apologise for any frustration.

In other news, we've now added support for Mixed Reality Capture using the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/755540/LIV/]LIV Client for SteamVR[/url] (check out the [url=https://liv.tv/]LIV website[/url] for more information). If you have the required capture setup, please let us know how well it works with the game!

As always, if you have any questions about the game, please let us know here or on Twitter ([url=https://twitter.com/SkywardDigital]@SkywardDigital[/url]) and we'll be glad to help.

- Skyward Digital

notes.title: RPG Merchant is now available!
notes.content:
RPG Merchant has now officially launched for Oculus Rift and HTC Vive! Jump into the shoes of a medieval shop assistant and face frantic challenges as you attempt to serve customers as quickly as possible - just try not to make too many mistakes!

We hope you enjoy the game! We plan to release updates with more content and fixes in the coming weeks. If you have any questions or bugs to report, please let us know here or on Twitter (@SkywardDigital) and we'll be happy to help.

- Skyward Digital
